questions.question: Find the average of natural numbers from 1 to 69. (both included)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **Arithmetic Progression** (consecutive numbers), the **Average** is the **middle term**.

Shortcut Formula: **Average = (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2**

⇒ Average = (1 + 69) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 70 ÷ 2 = 35

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Natural numbers** from 1 to 69.

**Formula:** Average = **Sum of all observations** ÷ **Number of observations (n)**

Sum of first **n natural numbers** = [n × (n + 1)] ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e63f0d5111a1ab53a0d936270ebc3f044f4393f6d64d70671638728a1eb826c.png] 

⇒ Here, **n** = 69

⇒ Sum = [69 × (69 + 1)] ÷ 2

⇒ Sum = (69 × 70) ÷ 2 = 69 × 35 = 2415

⇒ Average = 2415 ÷ 69

⇒ Average = 35

**∴ The correct answer is 35.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of First n Natural Numbers

The sum is calculated using the formula Sₙ = n(n + 1) ÷ 2.

Average of First n Even Numbers

The average of the first **n consecutive even numbers** starting from 2 is simply (n + 1).

Average of First n Odd Numbers

The average of the first **n consecutive odd numbers** starting from 1 is always equal to n.

Average of Square of First n Natural Numbers

The formula for the average of squares is [(n + 1)(2n + 1)] ÷ 6.</p

questions.question: If the diameter of the base and curved surfaced area of a cylinder are 14cm and 352 cm² ,respectively, then the total surface area of the cylinder is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the base of the cylinder = 14 cm

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of the cylinder = 352 cm²

**Formula Used:**

1. Radius of the base (r) = Diameter / 2

2. Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh

3. Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(r + h)

**Calculation:**

1. Calculate the radius:

Radius, r = 14 / 2

⇒ r = 7 cm

2. Use CSA to find the height (h) of the cylinder:

CSA = 2πrh

⇒ 352 = 2 × 22/7 × 7 × h

⇒ 352 = 44h

⇒ h = 352 / 44

⇒ h = 8 cm

3. Calculate the Total Surface Area (TSA):

TSA = 2πr(r + h)

⇒ TSA = 2 × 22/7 × 7 × (7 + 8)

⇒ TSA = 2 × 22/7 × 7 × 15

⇒ TSA = 2 × 22 × 15

⇒ TSA = 660 cm²

**The total surface area of the cylinder is 660 cm².**

questions.question: Shankar covers a certain distance by a car driving at 40 km/h and he returns to the starting point riding on a scooter with a speed of 20 km/h. Find the average speed of the whole journey.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the **distance** covered is the same for two parts of a journey, use the formula:

**Average Speed** = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

Average Speed = (2 × 40 × 20) ÷ (40 + 20) = 1600 ÷ 60 = 80/3 km/h

Average Speed = 26 2/3 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 26 2/3 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed during onward journey (S₁) = 40 km/h

Speed during return journey (S₂) = 20 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ea4d1df9e64523c64e214f83ceb973a76fef5fc6498e874ba0e6e169af09bc4.png] 

⇒ Let the **distance** between the starting point and the turning point be **d** km.

⇒ Time taken to travel from A to B (t₁) = d ÷ 40 hours.

⇒ Time taken to travel from B back to A (t₂) = d ÷ 20 hours.

⇒ Total distance covered = d + d = **2d** km.

⇒ Total time taken = (d ÷ 40) + (d ÷ 20) = (d + 2d) ÷ 40 = **3d ÷ 40** hours.

⇒ Average Speed = 2d ÷ (3d ÷ 40)

⇒ Average Speed = (2d × 40) ÷ 3d = 80 ÷ 3 km/h.

⇒ Average Speed = 26 2/3 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 26 2/3 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Different Distances

If distances d₁, d₂ are covered with speeds s₁, s₂, then Average Speed = (d₁ + d₂) ÷ (d₁/s₁ + d₂/s₂).

Harmonic Mean Property

When distances are equal, the average speed is the **Harmonic Mean** of the individual speeds.

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed for Three Equal Distances

If three equal distances are covered with speeds x, y, and z, then Average Speed = 3xyz ÷ (xy + yz + zx).</p

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 22?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Numbers: 645372, 893002, 654320, 602351

**Formula Used:**

A number is divisible by 22 if it is divisible by both 2 and 11.

**Calculation:**

1. Checking 645372:

Divisibility by 2: 645372 is even (last digit is 2) ⇒ Divisible by 2

Divisibility by 11: Sum of digits at odd places = 6 + 5 + 7 = 18

Sum of digits at even places = 4 + 3 + 2 = 9

Difference = 18 - 9 = 9 (Not Divisible by 11) ⇒ Not Divisible by 11

645372 is divisible by 22.</p

questions.question: A person spends 10% of his income on groceries, 10% on medicines, 20% on children's education, 15% on house rent, and he saves the remaining amount. If his monthly income is ₹30,000, find his savings.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Expenditure** % = 10% + 10% + 20% + 15% = 55%

Total **Savings** % = 100% − 55% = 45%

Savings Amount = 45% of ₹30,000 = 0.45 × 30,000

Savings = ₹13,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Monthly **Income** = ₹30,000

**Groceries** = 10% | **Medicines** = 10% | **Children's Education** = 20% | **House Rent** = 15%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89de3ba75da5d043ef423a384264711f71e79d3d8f61b6c36c821852604e09a4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total **Expenditure** = 10% + 10% + 20% + 15% = 55% of Income

⇒ **Savings** Percentage = 100% − 55% = 45%

⇒ **Savings** in Value = (45 ÷ 100) × 30,000

⇒ **Savings** = 45 × 300

⇒ **Savings** = ₹13,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Expenditure

When expenditures are given as simple percentages of the total income, they are additive: Total % = P₁ + P₂ + ... + Pₙ.

Remaining Balance Method

If the question says '% of the **remaining** amount', we use the multiplying factor: Savings = Income × (1 − r₁) × (1 − r₂)...

Income Formula

Income = Total Expenditure + Savings. This basic identity is used to find any one unknown variable.

questions.question: If 70% of the cost price of an article is equal to 40% of its selling price, what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

70% of the cost price (CP) = 40% of the selling price (SP)

**Formula Used:**

Profit Percentage = (SP - CP)/(CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price (CP) be x.

70% of CP = 40% of SP

⇒ 0.7 × x = 0.4 × SP

⇒ SP = (0.7 × x)/(0.4)

⇒ SP = 1.75 × x

Profit = SP - CP

Profit = 1.75 × x - x

Profit = 0.75 × x

Profit Percentage = (0.75 × x)/(x) × 100

Profit Percentage = 0.75 × 100

Profit Percentage = 75%

**The profit percentage is 75%.**

questions.question: What is the value of tan 570º?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Angle to find tan value = 570º

**Formula Used:**

tan(θ + 360º) = tan(θ)

**Calculation:**

To find tan 570º , we reduce the angle by subtracting multiples of 360º until we get an equivalent angle between 0º and 360º.

570º - 360º = 210º

Therefore, tan(570º) = tan(210º)

Now, tan(210º) = tan(180º + 30º)

Using the formula tan(180º + θ) = tan(θ) , we get:

tan(210º) = tan(30º)

And we know:

tan(30º) = 1/√3

However, since 210º is in the third quadrant where tan is positive, we have:

tan(210º) = tan(30º) = 1/√3

Therefore, the value of tan(570º) is 1/√3 .

questions.question: A box filled with gift articles weighs 25 kg. If the weight of the box and the gift articles, respectively, are in the ratio 1 ∶ 9, then the weight of the articles (in grams) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total weight of the box filled with gift articles = 25 kg

Ratio of the weight of the box to the weight of the gift articles = 1 ∶ 9

**Formula Used:**

Weight of gift articles = (Total weight × Ratio of gift articles) / (Sum of ratio parts)

**Calculation:**

Total ratio parts = 1 + 9 = 10

Weight of gift articles = (25 kg × 9) / 10

⇒ Weight of gift articles = 225 / 10

⇒ Weight of gift articles = 22.5 kg

Convert the weight into grams:

1 kg = 1000 grams

Weight of gift articles in grams = 22.5 kg × 1000

⇒ Weight of gift articles in grams = 22500 grams

**The weight of the articles is 22500 grams.**

questions.question: The edges of a rectangular box are in the ratio of 3 ∶ 5 ∶ 8, and its surface area is 632 cm². What will be the volume of the box?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **edges** = 3 : 5 : 8

Ratio of **surface area** = 2 × (3×5 + 5×8 + 8×3) = 2 × (15 + 40 + 24) = 158 units²

Given area 158 units² = 632 cm² ⇒ 1 unit² = 4 cm² ⇒ 1 unit = 2 cm

Actual **edges** are (3×2), (5×2), (8×2) = 6 cm, 10 cm, 16 cm

**Volume** = 6 × 10 × 16 = 960 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 960 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of edges of the **rectangular box** = 3 : 5 : 8

Total **Surface Area** (TSA) = 632 cm²

**Formula Used:**

TSA of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

Volume of a cuboid = l × b × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92deae9bacca405a98e7e5b824a2e2cf1e409a71a30d779c0654e07116573820.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the length (l), breadth (b), and height (h) be 3x, 5x, and 8x respectively.

⇒ 2(3x × 5x + 5x × 8x + 8x × 3x) = 632

⇒ 2(15x² + 40x² + 24x²) = 632

⇒ 2(79x²) = 632

⇒ 158x² = 632

⇒ x² = 632 ÷ 158 = 4

⇒ x = √4 = 2

⇒ Dimensions: l = 3×2 = 6 cm, b = 5×2 = 10 cm, h = 8×2 = 16 cm

⇒ **Volume** = 6 × 10 × 16 = 960 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 960 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The total area of all six faces of the cuboid, calculated as 2(lb + bh + hl).

Volume of a Cuboid

The space occupied by the box, calculated by the product of its three dimensions: l × b × h.

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside the box, given by √(l² + b² + h²).

Lateral Surface Area (LSA)

The area of the four vertical walls of the box, calculated as 2h(l + b).</p

questions.question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 15 days. B and C in 30 days and C and A in 45 days. In how many days will they complete the work if they start working together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B can complete a piece of work in 15 days.

B and C can complete a piece of work in 30 days.

C and A can complete a piece of work in 45 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work rate of A + B + C = 1/(Work rate of A and B) + 1/(Work rate of B and C) + 1/(Work rate of C and A)

Time taken when A, B, and C work together = 1 / (Work rate of A + B + C)

**Calculation:**

Let the work rates of A, B, and C be A, B, and C respectively.

A + B = 1/15

B + C = 1/30

C + A = 1/45

Adding these three equations:

(A + B) + (B + C) + (C + A) = 1/15 + 1/30 + 1/45

⇒ 2A + 2B + 2C = 1/15 + 1/30 + 1/45

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = (6 + 3 + 2) / 90

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 11 / 90

⇒ A + B + C = 11 / 180

Time taken when A, B, and C work together = 1 / (A + B + C)

⇒ Time = 1 / (11 / 180)

⇒ Time = 180 / 11

⇒ Time = 16 (4/11) days

**The correct answer is option 2.**
